description: We are a young robotics team passionate about space exploration, Arduino, robotics, and programming. Our project focuses on developing an intelligent Mars Rover capable of exploring Martian terrain, detecting obstacles, and identifying safe paths using sensors and NASA data. We are looking for creative teammates interested in hardware, coding, software, and space exploration
summary:
Our project, Mars Explorer, is a student-designed concept that combines Arduino robotics with Mars mapping.

We plan to build a small robotic rover that can move across a model of the Martian surface and use an ultrasonic sensor to detect obstacles. We also aim to create a simple map using NASA Mars images and data to identify rocky areas and suggest safer paths for exploration.

This project addresses the challenge by showing how robots and space data can work together to help explore the surface of Mars.

It is important because exploring Mars is difficult and potentially dangerous for humans. Using robotic rovers can help scientists study the planet, identify obstacles, and plan future exploration missions.
details:
Our project, Mars Explorer, is a student-designed robotic rover that aims to explore a model of the Martian surface and help identify safer paths.

The rover is planned to use an Arduino UNO as its main controller. It will move using DC motors and a motor driver, while an ultrasonic sensor will detect obstacles in front of it. When an obstacle is detected, the rover will stop and try to change direction.

We also plan to create a simple Martian map using NASA images and available Mars data to mark rocky areas, possible hazards, and suggested exploration routes.

The main benefits are learning how robots can explore difficult environments, detect obstacles, and support future space missions without putting astronauts at risk.

Our project is creative because it combines a real robotics learning experience with space exploration and mapping.

The planned tools include Arduino UNO, ultrasonic sensors, DC motors, a motor driver, batteries, and basic programming using Arduino IDE.

We will focus on keeping the design simple, affordable, safe, and suitable for young students to build and understand.
